req.title: Return 404 for unknown player ID
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player exists for the given ID on GET /players/{playerId}.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-003 requires GET /players/{playerId} to return HTTP 404 when no player exists for the given UUID. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a known UUID returns 200 with correct payload, (2) a negative case confirming a well-formed but non-existent UUID returns exactly 404, (3) a boundary case using a UUID that is one UUID-namespace step away from a known seeded ID to confirm the 404 path is not accidentally triggered by valid IDs, and (4) an additional negative case using a syntactically invalid UUID to confirm 422 (FastAPI path validation) rather than 404, distinguishing the two error paths. All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

expected: Response body contains firstName 'Anjali' and lastName 'Banerjee'

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_known_id_returns_200():
    player_id = '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == player_id
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'
    assert body['starting11'] == False

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_adjacent_uuid_not_in_db_returns_404():
    # One nibble away from seeded id 97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802
    adjacent_id = '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c803'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{adjacent_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 404
    # Also confirm the real seeded ID still returns 200 (both sides of boundary)
    real_id = '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    r2 = client.get(f'/players/{real_id}')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()['id'] == real_id

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_last_seeded_id_returns_200_and_first_missing_returns_404():
    last_seeded_id = '77a3ac92-52d1-48c4-871c-73988df20dc8'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{last_seeded_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == last_seeded_id
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 26
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Aditya'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Mehta'

    missing_id = 'ffffffff-ffff-4fff-bfff-ffffffffffff'
    r2 = client.get(f'/players/{missing_id}')
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    assert r2.status_code != 200
